Physics 2009-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2009-II.question: A perfect black body has the unique characteristic feature as
options: a good absorber and a good radiator
neither a radiator nor an absorber
Physics 2009-II.answer: a good absorber and a good radiator
Physics 2009-II.explanation: (c)  A perfect black body emits and absorbs all colours of light. A good absorber is a good emitter.

Physics 2009-II.explanation: (c)  Centrifugal force separates fat from milk.
